subject.title: Fix live orphan session transcript visibility

question: Should OpenClaw treat owner-scoped live transcript paths with missing session-store metadata as visible to the same scoped/requesting agent?
rationale: The patch appears mechanically sound, but it intentionally widens session-history visibility for an upgrade/state edge case that repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Accept scoped fallback
options.body: Approve the same-agent owner-scoped fallback as intended behavior because cross-agent and basename-only orphan hits remain fail-closed.

options.title: Require gateway replay
options.body: Ask for a live gateway memory_search or memory-wiki replay with refreshed session indexing before merge.

options.title: Defer to broader identity work
options.body: Pause this PR and handle the missing-store case under the broader session-memory identity policy issue.

recommendation.title: Accept scoped fallback
recommendation.body: Approve the same-agent owner-scoped fallback as intended behavior because cross-agent and basename-only orphan hits remain fail-closed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work by jalehman owns the closest memory/session identity refactor and SDK transcript identity boundary touched by this PR.
